user_stories.title: As a user I want to submit a contact form with validation so that I receive a confirmation message.
user_stories.description: The user should be able to fill out the contact form with required fields (name, email, subject, message) and submit it. The form should validate the input and return a 201 status code with the submission ID if successful. If any validation errors occur, the form should return a 400 status code.
acceptance_criteria: The user can fill out the contact form with required fields (name, email, subject, message).
The form validates the input and returns a 201 status code with the submission ID if successful.
If any validation errors occur, the form returns a 400 status code.

user_stories.title: As a user I want to check the health of the API so that I know it is running properly.
user_stories.description: The user should be able to access the health check endpoint (/health) and receive a 200 OK status code with the status. The endpoint should return a JSON object with the status information.
acceptance_criteria: The user can access the health check endpoint (/health).
The endpoint returns a 200 OK status code with the status information.
